priority_1.workout_details: 10 min warm-up jog ramping to Z2. 40 min continuous Zone 2 running at steady cadence (170-175 spm). Finish with 4 x 15-second light strides on grass with 45s walk rest. 5 min cool-down.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority to safely kickstart your acute volume after 11 days off. Rebuilds aerobic baseline and running mechanics without overstressing connective tissue.

priority_2.session_title: Cycling Sweet Spot Aerobic Engine Kickstart
priority_2.workout_details: 10 min warm-up (building to FTP). 3 x 8 min @ Sweet Spot (230W) with 3 min Zone 1 recovery between sets. 15 min Zone 2 steady spin. 5 min easy spin cool-down. Total time: 55 min.
priority_2.reason: Excellent low-impact alternative to build fitness load toward CTL 60 while direct running impact is mitigated. Stimulates cycling power (20-min target) safely.

priority_3.session_title: Leg Kinetic Chain & Core Stability Strength
priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Back Squats: 3 x 8 @ 65kg. Barbell Romanian Deadlifts: 3 x 8 @ 70kg. Standing Overhead Press: 3 x 8 @ 40kg. Heavy Sandbag Bear-Hug Carry: 3 x 40 meters (70kg sandbag). Hanging Knee Raises: 3 x 12.
priority_3.reason: Builds posterior chain strength and core stability to support running economy and cycling torque, ideal if you prefer non-impact load management today.
